title: Ophir
sourceLines: -2. A country celebrated for its gold and other valuable merchandise
.Products of, used by Solomon and Hiram 1Ki 9:28; 10:11; 2Ch 8:18; 9:10
.Jehoshaphat sends ships to, which are wrecked at sea 1Ki 22:48
.Gold of, proverbial for its fineness 1Ch 29:4; Job 22:24; 28:16; Ps 45:9; Isa 13:12
